skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — generate a 30-second video of a sunset over mountains with calm background...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial public release of "Video Generator Free Like Grok" skill — generate AI videos from text prompts for free.
- Supports 30-second video generation with audio, text overlays, and uploads up to 500MB (MP4, MOV, WebM, GIF).
- No account needed: automatic anonymous token provisioning and session management.
- Simple commands: generate, upload, export, check credits, and manage session with clear API routing for common actions.
- Cloud-based GPU video rendering delivers results in 1-2 minutes; credits system with 100 free credits on signup.
- Error handling for file types, size limits, credits, and session/authentication issues.
